Option B, tags, feels most natural. A link may be both “to read” and “Python,” so I don’t want to force it into one folder. Selecting multiple tags to narrow the list to bookmarks that have all of them also feels right.

When adding a tag, please suggest existing tags as I type so I can reuse one instead of accidentally creating slightly different versions. I’d still like to be able to create a new tag when needed.

Automatic grouping by website could be a helpful detail, but it shouldn’t replace tags as the main way of organising.
